observation.command: echo "=== processes ==="; ps aux | grep -Ei "tomcat|postgres|rabbit|java|mapproxy|mapserver|ldproxy" | grep -v grep; echo "=== listening ports ==="; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null || netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null; echo "=== which services ==="; for c in catalina.sh tomcat psql postgres rabbitmq-server rabbitmqctl docker python3 mapproxy-util mapserv ldproxy; do printf "%-20s " "$c"; command -v $c || echo "NOT FOUND"; done
